claims: Major cancellations such as airline flights entitle passengers to refunds.
If a flight is canceled, passengers are generally entitled to a refund, particularly if they choose not to travel, according to Southwest Airlines policies.
The U.S. Department of Transportation dashboard provides a way to check an airline's commitment to assisting passengers during cancellations within their control.
"Cancellation" refers to the act of calling off an arrangement.
"Cancellation" can also refer to the "gap" or slot created.
